tasks.dod: checkChoice returns ok only for an OPEN offer of the acting Freelancer in that Conversation whose option exists and whose record still exists, is owned and still fits, claimOffer moves OPEN to CHOSEN in the same transaction as the slot reservation and returns false on a lost race, releaseOffer moves CHOSEN back to OPEN, and checkChoice writes nothing, all proven by integration tests.

tasks.title: Turn propose_draft issues into the reply's offer, apply the turn's pins, and stream the data-offer part
tasks.dod: A drafting turn whose resolver issue is offer-able returns a pending offer built by offerFromIssues, streams one data-offer part with only its offerId after the text, a TOO_MANY issue gives the model the match count and no offer, and a re-called propose_draft inside a pinned turn keeps the pinned record, proven by integration tests with the scripted model.

tasks.title: Prove the press safety properties: injection fixture, uniform refusals, concurrent claims, release on failure, metadata-only spans
